derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and G1510 (εἰμί) (including its various inflections);
def: to be in company with, i.e. present at the time

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
